title: Isaiah 54
paragraphs: ¹ "Shout for joy, O barren woman, you who never bore a child! Break into song and cry out, you who were never in labor! For more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband," says the LORD. ² "Enlarge the space of your tent, stretch your curtains wide; do not hold back. Lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes. ³ For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will possess the nations and settle in their desolate cities. ⁴ Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood. ⁵ For your Maker is your husband — the LORD Almighty is his name — the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.

⁶ The LORD will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and grieved in spirit — a wife who married young, only to be rejected, says your God. ⁷ "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back. ⁸ In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you," says the LORD your Redeemer. ⁹ "To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again. ¹⁰ Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken, nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the LORD, who has compassion on you.

¹¹ "Afflicted city, storm-tossed and not comforted — I will rebuild you with turquoise, lay your foundations with sapphires. ¹² I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones. ¹³ All your children will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their peace. ¹⁴ In righteousness you will be established. Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you. ¹⁵ If anyone attacks you, it is not my doing — whoever attacks you will fall before you.

¹⁶ See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon for its work. And it is I who created the destroyer to work havoc. ¹⁷ No weapon forged against you will prevail, and every tongue that accuses you in judgment you will refute. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and this is their vindication from me," declares the LORD.
